venture.name: SpaceX (with xAI)
venture.team: Tens of thousands of people; xAI and X merged in February 2026.
venture.current_state: S-1 filed 2026-05-20 (ticker SPCX). Three segments: Space (launch), Connectivity (Starlink, about 61% of 2025 revenue), AI (xAI, about $3.2B revenue and about $6.4B operating loss in 2025). Starlink at 10.3M subscribers, ARPU falling. Starship delays top the risk factors.

core.source: SpaceX's stated mission (make life multiplanetary) and its S-1 segments; our wording.
core.promise: Access to space, and what space makes possible, at a cost and cadence no one else reaches: launch for anyone, and connectivity anywhere on Earth.
core.promised_to: Governments, satellite operators, and people and businesses anywhere on Earth.
core.must_not: Loss of crew, payload or public safety; and, since the merger, harmful or unlawful content delivered under the company's name.
core.competence: Reusable rockets and vertically integrated, high-cadence manufacturing of launch vehicles and satellites.

falcon.name: Falcon 9 / Heavy launch
falcon.description: Reusable launch; most of the world's mass to orbit.

starship.name: Starship
starship.description: Fully reusable super-heavy launch; still in test.

x.name: X
x.description: The social network, now in the AI segment.

orbital.name: Orbital data centres
orbital.allowed_from_reason: Needs Starship at cadence; described as a future plan.
orbital.description: Compute in orbit, powered by sunlight.
